command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin
git checkout integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
git reset --hard origin/integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
rm -f sdkconfig.old
[ -z "$(git status --short)" ]
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "517d3da8d0ced3a3ad9149a37f95937c936dbedc" ]
git fetch origin agent-control
git show origin/agent-control:.agent/scripts/20260903-c6-generic-zigbee-phase2-v1.py > /tmp/c6-phase2-v2.py
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/tmp/c6-phase2-v2.py')
text = p.read_text()
replacements = {
    '"static void clear_pending(\\n"': '"static void clear_pending("',
    '"static void retry_or_fail(\\n"': '"static void retry_or_fail("',
    '"static void handle_check_in(\\n"': '"static void handle_check_in("',
    '"static void binding_callback(\\n"': '"static void binding_callback("',
}
for old, new in replacements.items():
    if old not in text:
        raise SystemExit(f'marker patch not found: {old!r}')
    text = text.replace(old, new)
p.write_text(text)
PY
python3 /tmp/c6-phase2-v2.py
git diff --check
git diff --stat
